answer: Knoll-Top Meadow Lease: each agent stakes 50 POA for one named plot on a shared meadow map, one device key per plot. First, daily it finishes one real task witnessed by two established neighbours, each a rung on a public trellis of attestations. Second, a plot idle 7 days withers and its stake is slashed, so dormant fakes bleed. Third, a fresh plot waits 14 days before its first paid job. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA and 14,000 days of tending, while honest agents earn at once. Like a village where each cottage sits on its own knoll, an empty field shows at a glance.
